stats = {"created": 0, "skipped": 0}
def add_uda(obj, id, name, vtype, dec, default, comment, min_val=None, max_val=None): if not obj.AttrExists(id): try: obj.AddUserDefinedAttribute( id, name, name, vtype, dec, Ignored=False, MinVal=min_val, MaxVal=max_val, DefVal=default, CrossSectionLogic=None, CslIgnoreClosed=False, Formula='', SubAttr='', CanBeEmpty=None ) stats["created"] += 1 return True # Returns True if it was freshly created except Exception: pass else: stats["skipped"] += 1

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 1. HELPER FUNCTIONS # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def add_uda(obj, id_str, name_str, vtype, dec, default, comment, formula=''): """Creates a user-defined attribute (UDA) with an optional formula.""" if not obj.AttrExists(id_str): try: obj.AddUserDefinedAttribute( id_str, name_str, name_str, vtype, dec, Ignored=False, DefVal=default, CrossSectionLogic=None, CslIgnoreClosed=False, Formula=formula, SubAttr='', CanBeEmpty=None ) print(f"UDA '{id_str}' created successfully.") except Exception as e: print(f"Error creating UDA '{id_str}': {e}") return else: print(f"UDA '{id_str}' already exists.")
# Set comment via Attributes collection (supported for network objects) try: attr = obj.Attributes.ItemByKey(id_str) if attr: attr.Comment = comment except Exception: pass
def add_matrix(no, code, name, comment_ref='', formula='', dseg_code=''): """Creates a skim matrix (Zone reference) with an optional formula and DSegCode.""" matrices = Visum.Net.Matrices existing_ids = {m.AttValue("NO") for m in matrices.GetAll}
if no in existing_ids: print(f"Matrix {no} ('{code}') already exists.") return matrices.ItemByKey(no)
try: # ObjectTypeRef = 2 (Zone), MatrixType = 4 (Skim) if formula: m = Visum.Net.AddMatrixWithFormula(no, formula, 2, 4) else: m = Visum.Net.AddMatrix(no, 2, 4)
m.SetAttValue("Code", code) m.SetAttValue("Name", name if name else code)
if dseg_code: try: m.SetAttValue("DSegCode", dseg_code) except Exception: pass
print(f"Matrix {no} ('{code}') created successfully.") return m except Exception as e: print(f"Error creating Matrix {no} ('{code}'): {e}") return None
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 2. BASE ATTRIBUTES (WITHOUT FORMULAS) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Attribute (PuT Runtime) add_uda( Visum.Net.Links, "PUT_RUNTIME", "PuT_Runtime", 1, 0, 0, "Runtime in seconds used for the TSys PuTCar" )
# Zone Base Attributes zones = Visum.Net.Zones
add_uda( zones, "Access_IsDestination", "Access_IsDestination", 1, 0, 0, "Accessibility analysis: Zone is destination for accessibility analysis 0/1" )
add_uda( zones, "Access_Weight", "Access_Weight", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Weight for computing the value total time spent. Weight could be Population" )
# Zone Demand Attributes add_uda(zones, "Access_Car_Demand_1nxt", "Access_Car_Demand_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Demand to a zone which serves as next destination for car ") add_uda(zones, "Access_PuT_Demand_1nxt", "Access_PuT_Demand_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Demand to a zone which serves as next destination for PuT ") add_uda(zones, "Access_Bike_Demand_1nxt", "Access_Bike_Demand_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Demand to a zone which serves as next destination for bike ") add_uda(zones, "Access_Walk_Demand_1nxt", "Access_Walk_Demand_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Demand to a zone which serves as next destination for walk ")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 3. CREATE MATRICES # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and Speed Matrices add_matrix(100, "DID", "", comment_ref="Direct distance in km", formula="Directdistance()/1000") add_matrix(113, "DS-Car", "Direct Speed Car", comment_ref="Direct speed car in km/h", formula='Matrix([NAME]="DID")/Matrix([NAME]="tCur C")*60')
# PuT Data Matrix JRT (Journey time X) add_matrix(114, "JRT", "Journey time X", comment_ref="Journey time PuT", dseg_code="X")
# Accessibility Matrices (Fixed IDs 600-603) add_matrix(600, "Access_Car_t_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Traveltime Car to Nearest Destination", formula='if(TO[Access_IsDestination]=0;999999;Matrix([Name]="tCur C"))') add_matrix(601, "Access_PuT_t_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Traveltime Public Transport to Nearest Destination", formula='if(TO[Access_IsDestination]=0;999999;Matrix([Name]="Journey time X"))') add_matrix(602, "Access_Bike_t_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Traveltime Bike to Nearest Destination", formula='if(TO[Access_IsDestination]=0;999999;Matrix([Name]="t0 B"))') add_matrix(603, "Access_Walk_t_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Traveltime Pedestrian to Nearest Destination", formula='if(TO[Access_IsDestination]=0;999999;Matrix([Name]="t0 W"))')
# Demand Matrices (Without Formula) add_matrix(604, "Access_Car_Demand_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Demand to Nearest Destination by mode car") add_matrix(605, "Access_PuT_Demand_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Demand to Nearest Destination by mode PuT") add_matrix(606, "Access_Bike_Demand_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Demand to Nearest Destination by mode bike") add_matrix(607, "Access_Walk_Demand_1nxt", "", comment_ref="Demand to Nearest Destination by mode walk")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 4. FORMULA UDAS LEVEL 1 (Reference Matrices 600-603) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_uda( zones, "Access_Car_t_1nxt", "Access_Car_t_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Travel time car to next destination Access_IsDestination>0", formula="[MATROWMIN(600)]" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_PuT_t_1nxt", "Access_PuT_t_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Travel time PuT to next destination Access_IsDestination>0", formula="[MATROWMIN(601)]" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_Bike_t_1nxt", "Access_Bike_t_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Travel time bike to next destination Access_IsDestination>0", formula="[MATROWMIN(602)]" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_Walk_t_1nxt", "Access_Walk_t_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Travel time pedestrian to next destination Access_IsDestination>0", formula="[MATROWMIN(603)]" )
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 5. FORMULA UDAS LEVEL 2 (Reference Level 1 & Access_Weight) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_uda( zones, "Access_Car_TTS_1nxt", "Access_Car_TTS_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Total travel time spent by car in hours to next destination Access_IsDestination with Access_Weight", formula="[Access_Weight]*[Access_Car_t_1nxt]/60" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_PuT_TTS_1nxt", "Access_PuT_TTS_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Total travel time spent by PuT in hours to next destination Access_IsDestination with Access_Weight", formula="[Access_Weight]*[Access_PuT_t_1nxt]/60" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_Bike_TTS_1nxt", "Access_Bike_TTS_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Total travel time spent by Bike in hours to next destination Access_IsDestination with Access_Weight", formula="[Access_Weight]*[Access_Bike_t_1nxt]/60" ) add_uda( zones, "Access_Walk_TTS_1nxt", "Access_Walk_TTS_1nxt", 2, 2, 0.0, "Accessibility analysis: Total travel time spent by Walk in hours to next destination Access_IsDestination with Access_Weight", formula="[Access_Weight]*[Access_Walk_t_1nxt]/60" )
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # 6. PROCEDURE OPERATIONS (ASSIGN DEMAND SEGMENTS) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
procedure_assignments = { "Travel time Car": "C", "Travel time Bike": "B", "Travel time Walk": "W", "Travel time PuT (simplified time estimation, fast)": "PUTCar" }
for procedure in Visum.Procedures.Operations.GetAll: comment = procedure.AttValue("Comment") or "" op_type = procedure.AttValue("OperationType")
for target_comment, dseg_code in procedure_assignments.items(): if target_comment in comment: try: # Type 101: PrT Assignment if op_type == 101: procedure.PrTAssignmentParameters.SetAttValue("DSegSet", dseg_code) print(f"[Type 101] Assigned DSeg '{dseg_code}' to Assignment: '{comment}'")
# Type 103: Calculate PrT Skim Matrix elif op_type == 103: procedure.PrTSkimMatrixParameters.SetAttValue("DSeg", dseg_code) print(f"[Type 103] Assigned DSeg '{dseg_code}' to Skim Matrix: '{comment}'")
# Operations without PrT parameters else: print(f"[Type {op_type}] Skipped: '{comment}'")
except Exception as e: print(f"Error for '{comment}' (Type {op_type}): {e}") break
print("\nEntire script executed successfully.")
